reports.title: Amentum Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2027 Guidance
section: Amentum initiates the following fiscal year 2027 guidance which represents our views as of November 23, 2026:

(in millions, except per share data) | Fiscal Year 2027 Guidance
Revenues | $13,800 | - | $14,050
Adjusted EBITDA1 | $1,135 | - | $1,175
Adjusted Diluted EPS1 | $2.50 | - | $2.70
Free Cash Flow1 | At least $600

desk.period: Q4 fiscal 2026 (quarter to 2 Oct 2026); full year fiscal 2026
desk.headline: Q4 revenue down 8% to $3.62bn, below estimates; adjusted EPS $0.71 beat; first FY27 outlook and a first $500m buyback
results: Q4 revenue fell 8% to $3.62bn, short of the $3.70bn estimate; the company says an extra week in last year's quarter cut growth by about 9 points.
Adjusted EPS rose 13% to $0.71, ahead of the $0.66 estimate; GAAP net income jumped to $174m from $40m on lower amortisation and interest costs.
Digital Solutions revenue grew 3% for the year to $5.7bn, while Global Engineering Solutions fell 9% to $8.1bn as older programmes wound down.
Backlog rose to $48.3bn despite a roughly $1.5bn NASA de-booking; the year brought about $17bn of contract awards.
Q4 free cash flow was $370m; $287m went to early debt repayment, cutting net leverage to 2.7x, and the board approved a first $500m buyback.

guidance.summary: Amentum set its first fiscal 2027 outlook: revenue of $13.8–14.05bn (roughly flat to up 2% on $13.8bn), adjusted EPS of $2.50–2.70 and free cash flow of at least $600m. Both the revenue and EPS midpoints sit a little below analyst forecasts cited by Investing.com.

watch: Whether new contract wins turn into organic revenue growth in fiscal 2027.
The effect of NASA contract changes on revenue and backlog.
How quickly the new $500m buyback is used alongside further debt reduction.

sources.title: Amentum surges on earnings beat and buyback program — Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026
